news.title: 3-year-old dies, police charge 20-year-old with child cruelty, aggravated battery
news.summary: The Cobb County Police Department said a 20-year-old is in custody on multiple charges after a 3-year-old died at a local children’s hospital.

news.summary: A 20-year-old man was arrested on felony charges after a 3-year-old boy died days following an early-morning medical call at an Austell home, police said.

news.title: Cobb County man arrested, charged with elder abuse in death of 70-year-old
news.summary: The victim, identified as Linda Kilgore, was found deceased in her hotel room at The Western Inn on Windy Hill Road on Monday.

news.title: Man charged after woman found dead at Marietta hotel
news.summary: A 64-year-old Marietta man has been charged after a 70-year-old woman was found dead Monday in a hotel room in Marietta, Cobb County police said.

news.title: One injured in Tuesday morning shooting on Treasure Court

news.title: Left-turn collision in Powder Springs hospitalizes 2 drivers
news.summary: A left-turn collision at a busy Powder Springs intersection sent one driver to the hospital by ambulance with serious injuries Monday afternoon, according to Cobb County police.

news.title: Forest Park Council votes 3-2 against reinstating police chief
news.summary: Forest Park City Council members voted 3-2 Monday night against reinstating ousted Police Chief Brandon Criss, leaving him locked out of his job.
